name: com.mytoolz.uikit
description: Ready-made uGUI widgets: arc layout, swipeable card carousel, text-box and height fitters, shine and sparkle effects, spinner, and setting-bound strong toggle / switch button. Requires DOTween (https://dotween.demigiant.com/) and SerializeReferenceExtensions (https://github.com/mackysoft/Unity-SerializeReferenceExtensions).
